# Electric Client v0.10.3 - Table of Contents

> Elixir client for ElectricSQL

## Modules

- [Electric.Client](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.md): An Elixir client for [ElectricSQL](https://electric-sql.com).
- [Electric.Client.Authenticator](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Authenticator.md): Behaviour to authenticate a `Electric.Client.Fetch.Request`.
- [Electric.Client.Authenticator.MockAuthenticator](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Authenticator.MockAuthenticator.md): A pseudo-authenticating `Electric.Client.Authenticator` implementation.
- [Electric.Client.Authenticator.Unauthenticated](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Authenticator.Unauthenticated.md): Placeholder `Electric.Client.Authenticator` implementation that doesn't add
any authentication params or headers to the `Request`.

- [Electric.Client.EctoAdapter.ArrayDecoder](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.EctoAdapter.ArrayDecoder.md)
- [Electric.Client.Embedded](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Embedded.md)
- [Electric.Client.ExpiredShapesCache](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.ExpiredShapesCache.md): LRU cache for tracking expired shape handles.
- [Electric.Client.Fetch](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Fetch.md)
- [Electric.Client.Fetch.HTTP](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Fetch.HTTP.md): Client `Electric.Client.Fetch` implementation for HTTP requests to an
external Electric API server.
- [Electric.Client.Fetch.Pool](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Fetch.Pool.md): Coaleses requests so that multiple client instances making the same
(potentially long-polling) request will all use the same request process.

- [Electric.Client.Fetch.Request](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Fetch.Request.md)
- [Electric.Client.Fetch.Response](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Fetch.Response.md)
- [Electric.Client.Message.ChangeMessage](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Message.ChangeMessage.md)
- [Electric.Client.Message.ControlMessage](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Message.ControlMessage.md)
- [Electric.Client.Message.Headers](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Message.Headers.md)
- [Electric.Client.Message.MoveInMessage](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Message.MoveInMessage.md): Represents a move-in event from the server.
- [Electric.Client.Message.MoveOutMessage](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Message.MoveOutMessage.md): Represents a move-out event from the server.
- [Electric.Client.Message.ResumeMessage](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Message.ResumeMessage.md): Emitted by the synchronisation stream before terminating early. If passed
as an option to [`Client.stream/3`](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/`Electric.Client.stream/3`) allows for
resuming a shape stream at the given point.
- [Electric.Client.Mock](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Mock.md): Allows for mocking stream messages.
- [Electric.Client.Offset](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Offset.md): Represents an offset in the synchronisation stream from Electric.

- [Electric.Client.Poll](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Poll.md): Poll-based API for fetching shape changes.
- [Electric.Client.ShapeDefinition](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.ShapeDefinition.md): Struct for defining a shape.
- [Electric.Client.ShapeKey](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.ShapeKey.md): Generate canonical shape keys for cache lookup.
- [Electric.Client.ShapeState](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.ShapeState.md): State for polling a shape.
- [Electric.Client.TagTracker](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.TagTracker.md): Manages tag tracking for move-out support in Electric shapes.
- [Electric.Client.ValueMapper](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.ValueMapper.md): A behaviour for mapping the `value` fields of [`Message.ChangeMessage`](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/`Electric.Client.Message.ChangeMessage`) messages
from the shape stream.

- Exceptions
  - [Electric.Client.Error](https://electric-client.hexdocs.pm/Electric.Client.Error.md)
